entries.question: How do I get started?
entries.answer: Four steps: 1) Choose a plan and check out. 2) After payment confirms, your delivery pack arrives — normally within one business day — with the Agent installer, admin console installer, your Meeting ID and sign-in details. 3) Install the Agent and enroll your devices. 4) Sign in to the admin console and start your first authorized session. Step-by-step video guides are included in the pack.

entries.question: What platforms are supported?
entries.answer: The ConnectLive Agent runs on Windows devices. Technicians use the web admin console from a modern browser — no technician installation required to view a session. If you have a mixed fleet, mention it when you order and the team will advise.

entries.question: How quickly is a workspace provisioned?
entries.answer: Once payment confirms, the delivery pack normally lands within 24 hours — 48 hours at the outside on business days. Keep an eye on your spam folder and mark our address as safe.
